proof_summary: Above the respective thresholds, a witness gives Goldbach as \(n=(n-q)+q\) in the even case and Lemoine as \(n=(n-2q)+2q\) in the odd case, while direct finite searches handle all smaller required inputs. For any bound \(M\), apply the even case to \(n=2M+8014\): either \(q>M\), yielding the cousin pair \((q,q+6)\), or \(q\le M\), in which case \((n-q-6,n-q)\) is a cousin pair above \(M\), proving infinitude.
